title: qeedaalisso too finqittem fanah
intro: qaxmeqeeh leeda le rakaakayal, dadaltah tan ayyunti hirfeenit qadaagah arac finqisam idniseh. kabxah duddal tamixxigem kee dariifal tan caxaaxuwih buxaaxih manga, ta butta qadliino kee imaanal seeco foocal hayte. Uxih gadda kaxxiini sadu fan beyaah, data silal horizoonul gaaboowe.
clues: Nanu caxaaxuwi arac kee coox daabisiyyih fanat mannowta leedâ kabxah ayyuntak sugne.
Nanu sinam qeedaalisso kee qilsat duquurusneh, baaxol umaadoobi baxcisna.
Nanu ninni farmoytal diggowteh nen Yalla cabaanam kee qeedaalisso inkih naceem.
Nanu ninni farmoytal tusuuleh, usug numma yaabe kaa tekkek digaala kah tamaatem esserne.
Nanu silal ayroh digaalat yibbixen qammurre silal nee gufte wak.
Anu Bocoodih Sacaaba axcuk aaxigem, Shuqayb kak ruuben mara.
